actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The card's main model is the MJCF scene myoarm_bimanual.xml, whose root element is '<mujoco model="MuscleMimic MyoBiamanualArm">'
The repository registry maps the name bimanual to arm/myoarm_bimanual.xml and myofullbody to body/myofullbody.xml
The upstream load() builds the model with mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path and returns it with mujoco.MjData(model)
The scene includes the shared scene file ../scene/musclemimic_scene.xml
The scene includes the arm's asset and default-class definitions from ./assets/myoarm_bimanual_assets.xml
The arm is the fixed-base body named Bimanual, attached directly under worldbody at pos -.025 0.1 1
The scene includes the kinematic chain ./assets/myoarm_bimanual_body.xml inside the Bimanual body
The model sets the integration timestep to 0.002 s with <option timestep="0.002"/>
The nested default class muscle sets the muscle control range -1 to 1 (ctrllimited true, ctrlrange "-1 1")
The default class upperarm_muscle repeats the -1 to 1 control range for the upper-arm muscle actuators
The default class forearm_muscle sets the -1 to 1 control range for the forearm muscle actuators
The MyoBimanualArm row of the model table lists 76 joints (36 with finger muscles disabled) and 126 muscles (64 with finger muscles disabled)
The README states that the minimum required MuJoCo version for both models is mujoco==3.2.1

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one fixed model deterministically from one initial state; the bridge has no seed input and a reset restores the model defaults, so the same run repeats on the same engine but no seed selects a different initial state.  This package's fake was not compared with MuJoCo, so its trajectories are not evidence of the engine's.

gaps: the stand-in parses the card's MJCF for the actuator count, the per-actuator control ranges, the joint count and the timestep, but its integration is a placeholder first-order motion, not the muscular, tendon, contact, equality, mesh or sensor dynamics of the model
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran (no network, no pip)
the model file and its assets are read from the read-only upstream clone at runtime; the package copies none of them and the fake loads no mesh, texture or muscle parameter
only the card's models[0] (the bimanual arm) is served; the card's second model, musclemimic_models/model/body/myofullbody.xml, is not served by this package
no physical device is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
